summary: Typed live endpoint tools support projection (select) before MCP result-budget bounding, the same as offline/command-mirror tools already did. classes_catalog/classes_search/workouts_list wrap items under a top-level "data" key, so their select paths must be prefixed accordingly (data.<field>); every other typed endpoint has no wrapper. classes_catalog/classes_search/classes_show/classes_structure additionally omit verbose stream/media and instructor-bio fields by default (include_stream_urls/include_instructor_bios restore them). A regen must keep this pipeline order (stripFields -> verbose toggles -> select -> bound rendering) and keep the data-wrapped select description on those three tools.
reason: A 100-item classes_search response measured 7.58x over the MCP tool budget, most of it fixed per-call cost (stream URLs, join tokens, full per-instructor bio/Q&A/share-image blocks) unrelated to the query.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. Tests cover the deep-strip helper, independent per-toggle behavior via the real applyVerboseFieldToggles function, that toggle/select arg names are reserved against upstream forwarding, tool-schema declarations across all ten typed endpoint tools, and that select requires a "data." prefix on the three data-wrapped endpoints (a bare field name silently projects to "{}" otherwise). Deferred, pending live shape confirmation this environment can't provide: collapsing instructor records to {id,name} and collapsing user_caption_locales into captions' locale codes.
